name: Marika's Grandmother
source:
She is the former chairwoman and current head of the Myougi family as well as one of the leaders of the traditionalist faction.

[spoiler]She supports the traditionalists purely out of opposition to the Rousen'in family and plans to take action to ensure that the attempt fails.[/spoiler]

She is the former chairwoman and current head of the Myougi family as well as one of the leaders of the traditionalist faction.
